additional_exclusion_policy.consumed_c2_oracles: All catalog source fact IDs mentioned in the consumed C2 development/Test #1/#2/#3 oracle fixtures are excluded, including source-linked child/reference facts beyond the seven root witnesses.
additional_exclusion_policy.historical_full_catalog_replays: Full-catalog structural mapping diagnostics from C1.1/C2 replay reports are not treated as semantic exposure; they cover every catalog fact structurally and would incorrectly exclude the entire corpus. Their explicitly selected C1.1/C2 witness identities, actual review decisions, and source-pinned regression facts are excluded separately.
additional_exclusion_policy.manual_feature_c_reviews: Source IDs in the committed Feature C rule fixtures and completed C2 defensive setup review batch are excluded as prior manually reviewed or rule-example occurrences.
